environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A colossal classical marble sculpted hand emerging from a rough brutalist concrete pedestal, holding a miniature intricate labyrinth in its palm.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A floating terracotta-colored geometric sphere, faint vintage astronomical diagrams in the background, and halftone-printed clouds cutting across the marble wrist

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A massive, perfectly round terracotta sun partially obscured by a thick brutalist concrete archway, with an upside-down antique plaster column hanging from the top of the arch.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A flock of vintage illustrated swallows flying through the negative space, floating textured concrete cubes, and subtle charcoal dotted grid lines.

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A cross-section of a brutalist concrete spiral staircase that organically morphs into the leaves of a giant, vintage-illustrated desert agave plant.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: Halftone-printed lunar surface cutouts, floating terracotta-colored geometric triangles, and a torn paper edge revealing a charcoal-grey void.

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A colossal, horizontally reclining classical marble Venus, sliced open lengthwise. Instead of anatomy, her torso contains a highly detailed, horizontal brutalist concrete subway station with endless echoing platforms.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A flock of oversized vintage-illustrated moths carrying torn newspaper fragments, a massive flat terracotta sun cut exactly in half by the horizon line, and halftone-printed ocean waves crashing against the concrete platforms.

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A panoramic surreal procession of several floating brutalist concrete islands spread across the wide canvas. Each island carries a giant vintage-illustrated human sensory organ (a massive eye, an ear, an anatomical heart) sprouting dry desert flora.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: Charcoal technical grid lines mapping an imaginary constellation across the wide background, disconnected concrete staircases leading into flat ochre voids, and vintage planetary cutouts rolling along a very thin, perfectly straight dotted baseline.

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A vast, perfectly horizontal brutalist concrete dam stretching almost across the entire frame. Instead of water, the dam is holding back a dense, sideways-growing forest made entirely of antique plaster Roman columns and giant vintage-illustrated blooming roses.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A large faded geometric terracotta triangle pointing downwards from the top edge, vintage anatomical diagrams of bird wings floating quietly in the wide negative space, and a flat charcoal-grey moon partially hidden by rough torn paper edges.
